launcher.notes: CRASH FIX for every machine: the game died at 'Initializing game' with java.lang.IllegalAccessError (RendererLivingEntity.field_77045_g from LayerMooshroomMushroom) right after OptiFine loaded. Root cause: the launcher passed OptiFine's tweaker BEFORE the Forge/FML tweaker, so OptiFine rewrote the vanilla renderer classes first and FML then skipped Forge's binary patches for them (checksum mismatch) - the field Forge makes public stayed protected and OptiFine's patched mooshroom layer hit it cross-package. The launch order is now Forge first, OptiFine second - the exact order every stock Forge 1.8.9 + OptiFine HD U M5 install uses. A/B verified on the real stack: old order dies at RenderManager init, new order reaches the main menu and keeps running. NO jars changed - Ultra Forge (ultra5) and Kinetrix Client (3.3.8) are byte-identical to 2.7.5; worlds, servers and settings untouched. Update the launcher and PLAY.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. The hub now uses the module menu window proportions (no more near-fullscreen). New "Customize Cosmetics" button on the pause screen for in-world/server customization. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.
